## Checklist

- [ ] The change comes with tests (a bug fix with a test that fails without it).
- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes, or I ran the relevant subset and list it here (and what I could not run, and why).
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, personal data, host names or IP addresses of a real installation (`pnpm check:leaks`).
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behaviour, configuration or operation changes (`docs/`, README, guides).
- [ ] User-visible changes have a line under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, Developer Certificate of Origin — see `CONTRIBUTING.md`).
- [ ] UI changes include before/after screenshots (redacted), or this change has no UI part.
